reason: Consolidate lessons from PR #209/#210 dependency consolidation: Playwright browser binary sync, Stryker jest-runner CommonJS config, visual baseline regeneration, image-actions bot corruption, and Docker volume cache management are durable patterns that will recur on every major dependency upgrade.
evidence: PR #209 consolidated 4 distinct CI failures into fixes: (1) Playwright 1.57→1.61 required bumping Playwright.Dockerfile base image to v1.61.1-jammy; (2) Stryker's jest-runner loaded testEnvironment via raw require.resolve without <rootDir> expansion — fixed by rewriting as CommonJS .cjs; (3) WebKit rendering changed ~1px in v1.61.1 — regenerated 76 webkit visual baselines; (4) calibreapp/image-actions bot lossily recompressed PNGs — added ignorePaths: ['tests/**'] and force-pushed uncompressed baselines.
